# Airvoz

> > Airvoz is a free AI voice generator offering 500+ lifelike voices across 144+ languages for text-to-speech conversion, voiceover creation, and multimedia content production.

Airvoz provides a no-registration, browser-based platform for converting text into natural-sounding speech with support for diverse languages, regional accents, and export formats. The service is designed for content creators, educators, and accessibility needs across video platforms like YouTube and TikTok.

## Core Features

- [Free AI Voice Generator](https://airvoz.com/en/ai-voice-generator): AI voice generator with 500+ voices, unlimited characters, and video content support
- [Text to Speech Converter](https://airvoz.com/en/text-to-speech): Free text-to-speech converter with 100+ languages, MP3 download, and no registration required
- [Voice Selection](https://airvoz.com/en/voices): Browse 500+ realistic voices for text-to-speech synthesis across multiple genders and accents

## Language Support

- [144+ Languages](https://airvoz.com/en/languages): AI voice generator supporting 144+ languages with authentic accents and regional variations for pronunciation learning
- [Language Support (Root)](https://airvoz.com/languages): Comprehensive language support page featuring 144+ languages with authentic accents and pronunciation learning resources
